9902.commentary: (SNa) asm'ābhijappanti janā anekā'ti anekajanā amhe abhijappanti. ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ brahmā, mahābrahmā, abhibhū, anabhibhūto, aññadatthu'daso, vasavattī, issaro, kattā, nimmātā, seṭṭho, sajitā, vasī, pitā bhūtabhabyānan'ti evaṃ patthenti pihentī'ti.

ayaṃ vassāno'tu, asmiñ'ca utumhi aṭṭha uposathā, iminā pakkhena, eko uposatho sampatto, eko uposathā atikkantā, cha uposathā avasiṭṭhā.

9907.commentary: (DNa) asmimānasamugghāto'ti arahattamaggo. arahattamaggaphalavasena hi nibbāne diṭṭhe puna asmimāno n'atthī'ti arahattamaggo asmimānasamugghāto'ti vutto. (ANa) asmimānasamugghātāyā'ti asmī'ti pavattassa navavidhassa mānassa samugghāt'atthāya. (UDa) asmimānasamugghātāyā'ti asmī'ti uppajjanakassa navavidhassa mānassa samucchedan'atthāya.

examples.text: asubhā bhāvetabbā rāgassa pahānāya, mettā bhāvetabbā byāpādassa pahānāya, ān'āpānassati bhāvetabbā vitakk'upacchedāya, aniccasaññā bhāvetabbā asmimānasamugghātāya.
aniccasaññino, bhikkhave, anattasaññā saṇṭhāti. anattasaññī asmimānasamugghātaṃ pāpuṇāti diṭṭh'eva dhamme nibbānan'ti.

9911.commentary: (ANa) asmī'ti, bhikkhave, satī'ti, bhikkhave, yadetaṃ ajjhattaṃ khandhapañcakaṃ upādāya taṇhā-māna-diṭṭhi-vasena samūhaggāhato asmī'ti hoti, tasmiṃ satī'ti attho. (ANa) asmī'ti asmimāno.

examples.text: puṇṇo nāma, āvuso, āyasmā mantāṇiputto amhākaṃ navakānaṃ sataṃ bah'ūpakāro hoti. so amhe iminā ovādena ovadati, upādāya, āvuso ānanda, asmī'ti hoti, no anupādāya.

attā hi attano nātho, attā hi attano gati, tasmā saññamay'attānaṃ, assaṃ bhadraṃ'va vāṇijo.

9972.meaning2: deserving the bag of ashes as punishment

examples.text: ahaṃ, bhante, pāpakammaṃ akāsiṃ gārayhaṃ assapuṭaṃ. yena me āyasmanto attamanā honti taṃ karomī'ti.

9973.meaning1: bag of ashes (used as symbolic punishment)
9973.meaning2: bag of ashes (used as symbolic punishment)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso kāḷakaṃ vatthaṃ paridhāya kese pakiritvā assapuṭaṃ khandhe āropetvā mahājanakāyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā

9974.meaning1: name of a town in Aṅga

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅgesu viharati assapuraṃ nāma aṅgānaṃ nigamo.
hatthibandhaṃ assabandhaṃ, gopurisañ'ca maṇḍalaṃ, chavaḍāhakaṃ pupphachaḍḍakaṃ, sadhanam'anupatanti nāriyo.

9980.commentary: (SNa) assame'ti āvasathe. (SNPa) keṇiyassa jaṭilassa assamo'ti keṇiyassa assamaṃ nivesanaṃ.

examples.text: tena h'āyasmanto yena rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assamo ten'upasaṅkamatha, app'eva nāma labheyyātha bhagavato sammukhā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savanāyā'ti.
paṭhamaṃ attanā pabbajitvā pacchā parisaṃ pabbājetvā assamapadaṃ bhājetvā adāsi
mayañ'hi pubbe assamaṇā'va samānā samaṇ'amhā'ti paṭijānimha, abrāhmaṇā'va samānā brāhmaṇ'amhā'ti paṭijānimha, anarahanto'va samānā arahant'amhā'ti paṭijānimha.
antamaso tiracchānagatāya'pī'ti tiracchānagat'itthiyā'pi methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo, pag'eva manuss'itthiyā. tena vuccati, antamaso tiracchānagatāya'pī'ti.

9982.meaning2: bogus monk, who has fallen from the monkshood

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo asuci saṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakamm'anto, assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño, abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño, antopūti avassuto kasambujāto.

9983.meaning1: something not done by a monk; not characteristic of a monastic

examples.text: yassa kho, gāmaṇi, jātarūparajataṃ kappati, pañca'pi tassa kāmaguṇā kappanti. yassa pañca kāmaguṇā kappanti, ek'aṃsen'etaṃ, gāmaṇi, dhāreyyāsi assamaṇadhammo asakyaputtiyadhammo'ti.

9984.meaning1: state of not being a monk; not an ascetic

9985.commentary: (VINa) buddhavevacanāni vā'ti buddhassa vā pariyāyanāmāni… asakyaputtiyassa vā. tattha vaṇṇapaṭṭhāne āgataṃ nāmasahassaṃ upāligāthāsu (ma ni 2.76) nāmasataṃ aññāni ca guṇato labbhamānāni nāmāni buddhavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. sabbāni'pi dhammassa nāmāni dhammavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. esa nayo sabbattha.

9986.meaning1: not a nun; no longer a monastic

9992.commentary: (SNa) aparabhāge pana okkākarājakāle brāhmaṇā imāni cattāri saṅgahavatthūni imañ'ca raṭṭhasampattiṃ parivattetvā uddhaṃmūlakaṃ katvā assamedhaṃ purisamedhan'ti ādike pañca yaññe nāma akaṃsu. tesu assam'ettha medhan'ti vadhantī'ti assamedho.

examples.text: assamedhaṃ purisamedhaṃ, sammāpāsaṃ vājapeyyaṃ niraggaḷhaṃ, mahāyaññā mah'ārambhā, na te honti mahapphalā.

9993.meaning1: horse for riding; horse as a vehicle
9993.meaning2: horse for riding; horse as a vehicle

9995.meaning1: name of a lunar month; October-November
9995.meaningLit: yoked to a horse; i.e. charioteer

examples.text: so pana vassāno utu sāvaṇapoṭṭhapādamāsā, assayujakattikamāsā sarado, māgasiraphussamāsā hemanto, māghaphaggunamāsā sisiro, cittavesākhamāsā vasanto, jeṭṭh'āsaḷhamāsā gimho utū'ti veditabbo.
